title: Console data module generation
responsibility: Turns recognized history-index files into server module text and estimates the resulting bundled size.

inputs.name: consoleDataModules.files
inputs.description: History-index files with relative paths and bytes. Recognized JSON records and hash-named media are converted; unrelated paths are ignored.

inputs.name: bundledSize.modules
inputs.description: Generated host files whose text sizes and individually gzipped sizes should be summed.

outputs.name: consoleDataModules
outputs.description: Host file entries under src/lib/server/harness/data: JSON default-exports its text; media default-exports base64 and exports its extension-derived MIME type. This function does not write files.

outputs.name: bundledSize
outputs.description: File count, total contents string length and sum of gzipped byte lengths, or null for an empty list.
